title: 2 Except “Thefts (ordinary)” which remained practically steady, and “Cheating” which showed an increase by 1·8%, all the offences against property, including such heinous crimes as “Dacoity”, “Robbery” and “Housebreaking”, showed substantial decrease. As against this, there was an increase in all forms of crime against the person; “Murder” showing an increase by 0·5%, “Kidnapping and Abduction” by 6·9%, “Riots” by 8·2% and miscellaneous offences against persons by 1·1%. This trend of increase in offences against persons was noticed last year also. ## INCIDENCE OF CRIME IN STATES/UNION TERRITORIES
